summary.text: Debra Altschiller is a Democratic state senator from New Hampshire who has represented District 24 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She previously served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 19 from 2016 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Altschiller earned a B.A. in communication and media studies from the University of Massachusetts at Amherst.

Her career experience includes working as a community relations event coordinator with Haven NH, a community outreach events coordinator with A Safe Place/SASS (Sexual Assault Support Services), and a freelance writer with Altschiller & Company.
She volunteered with the Exeter Area General Federation of Women's Clubs and Stratham Memorial School.

Altschiller assumed office in the State Senate on December 7, 2022, and in the 2025-2026 session serves on the Senate Education, Education Finance, Senate Executive Departments and Administration, and Senate Judiciary committees.
